turns.question: what is Article 11?
turns.answer:
Article 11 is the part of the Illinois Pension Code that governs the City of Chicago’s municipal employees’ annuity and benefit fund.

It covers retirement annuities, minimum annuities, widow’s and children’s benefits, employee and city contributions, service credit, and the Fund’s financing. For a retirement annuity, Section 11-134 provides minimum-annuity rules based on age, service, and highest average annual salary. Section 11-149 limits an age-and-service annuity to 60% of highest salary, subject to stated exceptions. Your record places you in Article 11 — tell me if that is not right.
